name: EEGPrep
summary: EEGPrep is an automated preprocessing tool for human EEG data built on the validated EEGLAB pipeline, here implemented in Python. It applies clean_rawdata for artifact rejection and ICA then ICLabel to identify artifactual muscle components.

parameters.description: EGPrep is an automated preprocessing tool for human EEG data built on the validated EEGLAB pipeline, here implemented in Python. It applies clean_rawdata for artifact rejection and ICLabel to identify artifactual muscle components. This pipeline was reported to outperform all other pipelines evaluated in MNE, FieldTrip and Brainstorm, as shown in Figure 5 of https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-023-27528-0.
